age.evidence: "Behavioral testing on the open field test (OFT), elevated plus maze (EPM), and forced swim test (FST) was performed in adulthood." ... "assessed for anxiety behavior in the open field test (OFT) (P90) and elevated plus maze (EPM) (P100)"

sex.evidence: "Male Sprague-Dawley rats bred in the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research animal facility ... were used for all experiments."

dosing.doses_raw: DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21
dosing.evidence: "pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21 (PNDOI) or vehicle (5% sucrose) (Ctrl) (n = 6–8 per group)."

handling.evidence: "Pups received oral administration via a feeding needle ... within 3 minutes to minimize handling stress" — no deliberate handling-habituation protocol is described.

group_housing.evidence: "Pups were weaned at postnatal day (P)28, and male pups were group housed into adulthood."

day_night_flipped.evidence: "maintained on a 12-hour light-dark cycle" ... "behavioral tests were carried out within the light phase."

assays.assay_description: Adult rats (P90) released at one corner of a 100 x 100 x 70 cm arena in a dimly illuminated room; exploratory behaviour recorded for 5 min with EthoVision tracking. Measures: total distance, percent path length, percent time and number of visits to the centre, number of rears. Psychedelic-relevant cohort: chronic postnatal DOI (PNDOI) vs vehicle control.

application_type.evidence: "pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21" (oral administration via a feeding needle)

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the open field arena is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: "Animals were released at one corner of the arena and exploratory behavior was recorded with an automated tracking system for 5 minutes."

food_restriction.evidence: "ad libitum access to food and water" in the home cage; no food present in the open field arena during the 5-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: "ad libitum access to food and water" in the home cage; no water present in the open field arena during the 5-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: "Pups received treatment with either vehicle (Ctrl) or DOI (postnatal DOI [PNDOI]) daily from postnatal day (P)2 to P21 and were assessed for anxiety behavior in the open field test (OFT) (P90)" — ~69 days after the last dose.

sample_size.evidence: "pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21 (PNDOI) or vehicle (5% sucrose) (Ctrl) (n = 6–8 per group)"

outcomes.summary: Chronic postnatal DOI (2 mg/kg, p.o., P2–P21) increased anxiety-like behaviour in the open field in adulthood (P90), with significant decreases in percent path length and percent time in the centre of the arena and a trend toward fewer centre visits. Total distance travelled was unchanged, indicating no general locomotor effect.
outcomes.statistics: *p < .05 as compared with Ctrl (Student t test); number of visits to centre p = .08 (trend)
outcomes.evidence: "Postnatal DOI animals showed a significant decline in percent path length (Figure 3C), percent time spent (Figure 3D), and a trend (p = .08) toward a decline in the number of visits (Figure 3E) to the center of the OFT arena."

B1_num_measures.evidence: "We assessed total distance covered within the arena, path length, and time spent in the center; number of visits to the center; and number of rears in the arena."

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only totals over the 5-min session are reported; no within-session time binning.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions, sequences, or bout microstructure reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: "number of rears in the arena" — rearing, a natural exploratory act, was scored (Figure S1).

B5_social.evidence: Open field anxiety test; no social stimulus or social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate anxiety/exploration test; no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: "All behavioral tracks were analyzed using the Ethovision tracking system (Noldus, Wageningen, Netherlands)." — position tracking only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses were univariate t tests and ANOVAs; no PCA/clustering reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: "the arena (100 cm × 100 cm × 70 cm) was placed in a dimly illuminated room"

E2_shelter.evidence: Open arena with no enclosed refuge described; definitionally absent.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding or substrate mentioned in the open field arena.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material mentioned in the testing apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects mentioned in the open field arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single square arena with a virtual centre zone; no physical compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: "Animals were released at one corner of the arena" — tested individually.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the open field arena during the 5-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: "exploratory behavior was recorded with an automated tracking system for 5 minutes" at P90, once.

D2_session_duration.evidence: "recorded with an automated tracking system for 5 minutes"

D3_recording_days.evidence: OFT performed on a single day in adulthood (P90).

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug behavioural recording; dosing began at P2.

D5_followup.evidence: DOI dosed P2–P21 and animals tested at P90, i.e., many weeks after the last administration.

assays.assay_description: Adult rats (P100) released into the centre of an elevated plus maze (platform 50 cm above ground; two open and two closed arms, 45 × 10 cm) facing an open arm; behaviour assessed for 5 min with EthoVision tracking. Measures: total distance, percent path length and percent time in open and closed arms, number of rears. Psychedelic-relevant cohort: chronic postnatal DOI (PNDOI) vs vehicle control.

application_type.evidence: "pups received DOI (2 mg/kg, Sigma-Aldrich) orally from P2 to P21"

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the elevated plus maze is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: "Animals were released into the center of the maze facing the open arm, and behavioral measures were assessed for 5 minutes."

food_restriction.evidence: "ad libitum access to food and water" in the home cage; no food on the maze during the 5-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: "ad libitum access to food and water" in the home cage; no water on the maze during the 5-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: "Pups received treatment with either vehicle (Ctrl) or DOI ... daily from postnatal day (P)2 to P21 and were assessed for anxiety behavior in the ... elevated plus maze (EPM) (P100)" — ~79 days after the last dose.

sample_size.evidence: "Data are the mean ± SEM ... percent path length and percent time in the open and closed arms of the EPM (n = 6–8 animals/group)."

outcomes.summary: Chronic postnatal DOI (2 mg/kg, p.o., P2–P21) evoked anxiety-like behaviour on the EPM in adulthood (P100): significantly decreased percent path length in the open arms and increased percent path length in the closed arms, with a trend toward increased time in the closed arms and no change in percent time in open arms. Total distance travelled was unaltered.
outcomes.statistics: *p < .05 as compared with Ctrl (Student t test); percent time in closed arms p = .07 (trend)
outcomes.evidence: "On the EPM, PNDOI animals showed a significant decrease in percent path length in the open arms (Figure 3H), increased percent path length in the closed arm (Figure 3I), and a trend (p = .07) toward an increase in time spent in the closed arms (Figure 3J), with no change in percent time in the open arms (Figure 3K)."

B1_num_measures.evidence: "Analysis was performed for total distance covered within the maze, path length, and time spent in the open and closed arms and the number of rears in the maze."

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals over 5 min are reported; no within-session binning.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition, sequence or bout-structure analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: "the number of rears in the maze" — rearing, a natural exploratory act, was scored (Figure S1).

B5_social.evidence: EPM anxiety test; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate avoidance test; no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: "All behavioral tracks were analyzed using the Ethovision tracking system" — position tracking only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: "The EPM consisted of a platform elevated 50 cm from the ground with two open and closed arms (45 × 10 cm)."

E2_shelter.evidence: Closed arms are part of the apparatus design, not an enclosed refuge — definitionally absent.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned on the maze; definitionally absent.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material on the maze; definitionally absent.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects on the maze.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform; per rubric, not scored as multiple compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: "Animals were released into the center of the maze facing the open arm" — tested individually.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water available on the maze.

D1_continuity.evidence: One 5-min EPM session per animal at P100.

D3_recording_days.evidence: EPM performed on a single day in adulthood (P100).

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug behavioural recording; dosing began at P2.

D5_followup.evidence: DOI dosed P2–P21 and animals tested at P100, i.e., long after the last administration.

judge_notes: Only the PNDOI (postnatal DOI) cohorts involve a psychedelic compound; fluoxetine, ketanserin, MDL100907, SB242084 and WAY-100635 arms are not psychedelics, so the FST (run only in PNFlx ± antagonist cohorts, never with DOI) was excluded and the qPCR gene-expression work was dropped as non-behavioural.
Two surviving assays: Open Field Test (P90) and Elevated Plus Maze (P100), each a single paradigm; all drug-group variants collapsed per rubric.
B4 scored 1 for both assays (modal across candidates, 2/3): Methods explicitly state number of rears was assessed in both the OFT and EPM (Figure S1), a natural exploratory act.
D5 scored 1 for both assays (modal, 2/3): DOI dosing ended at P21 and behavioural testing occurred at P90/P100, far beyond 24 h post-dose. gemma4's 'No' contradicts the paper.
B1 set to '4-6' (score 2) for both assays; gemma4 labelled the category '2-3' while assigning 2 points — label corrected to match the listed measures (distance, path length, time, visits, rears).
time_to_assay minutes recomputed from the stated postnatal days (P21 last dose → P90 OFT = 99,360 min; → P100 EPM = 113,760 min).
day_night_flipped scored 'no' (modal, 2/3): paper states a 12-h light–dark cycle and that testing was carried out within the light phase, with no mention of reversal.
study_id set to Sarkar2013 (modal; manuscript accepted Nov 2013, DOI 10.1016/j.biopsych.2013.11.005).
